support_claim: Commercial notes establish that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity, and billing and contract records ground the two referents to those respective name forms.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that Helion Robotics Ltd (CRM operating name) and Helion Robotics Limited (used on invoices and at Companies House) are the same legal entity.
propositions.relevance: Links the name form used as MSA-HELION-2019 counterparty (Helion Robotics Ltd.) to the name billed in invoices (Helion Robotics Limited), supporting that billing:Helion Robotics Limited and contract:MSA-HELION-2019 denote the same legal counterparty.

propositions.proposition: Invoices record billed_name as Helion Robotics Limited.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the billing referent billing:Helion Robotics Limited to the legal name Helion Robotics Limited appearing in billing records.

propositions.proposition: MSA-HELION-2019 names Helion Robotics Ltd. as the contract counterparty.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the contract referent contract:MSA-HELION-2019 to the legal name Helion Robotics Ltd. as its named counterparty.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes identify Helion Industrial Systems Ltd as a different company that sold sensors in 2018 and has no current MSA.
propositions.relevance: Distinguishes a similarly named Helion entity from the Helion Robotics parties under review; does not establish distinctness between the two candidate referents.
